paraphrase: Avalokiteśvara, great treasure of compassion without object; Mañjuśrī, lord of stainless wisdom; (Vajrapāṇi, destroyer of all māras;) Tsongkhapa, crown jewel of the sages of the Land of Snows — Lobsang Drakpa, I make requests at your feet.
notes: The five-line form; the nine-line form adds Vajrapāṇi and other lines. Wording recalled.
